nodes.label: lime-field-paint.jpg
nodes.description: Monochrome lime-green oil/acrylic landscape painting of rural farmland with farmstead, scattered trees, open field, and distant hills under pale sky; strong impasto brush texture.

nodes.label: Rural lime-green landscape
nodes.description: Wide pastoral scene: open green field, farm buildings mid-horizon, trees left/center/right, rolling hills far background, pale green sky.

nodes.label: Farmstead buildings
nodes.description: Cluster of farm buildings near center horizon: main house/barn with pitched roof and chimney-like form, adjacent shed/barn with gable roof, smaller outbuildings.

nodes.label: Open agricultural field
nodes.description: Foreground and midground: broad tilled/pasture field with soft undulations, brush-textured grass/crops, path-like darker strokes left-center.

nodes.label: Scattered deciduous trees
nodes.description: Multiple rounded-canopy trees: small ones left, medium mid-left near farm, larger fuller trees right foreground/midground; painted with dabbed foliage texture.

nodes.label: Distant rolling hills
nodes.description: Soft low mountain/hill range on far horizon behind farmstead, slightly cooler/darker green than field.

nodes.label: Pale green sky
nodes.description: Upper half: nearly empty pale lime sky with horizontal impasto strokes, no clouds distinctly rendered.

nodes.label: Monochrome lime palette
nodes.description: Entire image rendered in single hue family: lime/sage greens from near-white sky to darker foliage and roof shadows; no other colors.

nodes.label: Impasto brushwork
nodes.description: Visible thick paint strokes and directional texture across sky, field, and foliage; painterly rather than photorealistic.

nodes.label: Pastoral landscape genre
nodes.description: Classic rural idyll composition: farm, trees, open land, distant hills; calm agricultural mood.

nodes.label: Wide horizontal composition
nodes.description: Panoramic/banner aspect ratio; horizon roughly mid-lower third; farmstead as central focal anchor; trees frame left and right.

nodes.label: Serene rural mood
nodes.description: Quiet, still, peaceful atmosphere; no figures or animals; soft light; contemplative farmland scene.
